what: ITT makes engineered components: pumps and valves for industrial and energy use, brake pads and shock absorbers for cars, and connectors for aerospace, defence and rail.
customers: Chemical and energy processors, carmakers and their suppliers, aerospace and defence contractors, and rail operators.
money: brake pads, shock absorbers and sealing for vehicles and rail
pumps and valves for chemical, energy and general industry
connectors and control components for aerospace and defence
moat: Components qualified into vehicle and industrial platforms, especially brake pads approved by carmakers, which are then supplied for the model's life.
risks: European car production, a large market for its brake business, has been falling
opportunities: Revenue grew about 8% last year and about 10% a year over three years
Analysts see about 22% upside from current levels
Aftermarket brake pads and pump parts grow regardless of new vehicle or plant builds
watch: Organic order growth and Motion Technologies margins.
